pc_changelog:
v4.4.0 — Fluid 120 FPS Scrolling, Native Vector UI & P2P Hardening

• Ultra-smooth 60/120 FPS list scrolling physics, lower latency, and touchpad mid-scroll catch and halt
• Native SymbolIcons overhaul and dedicated back-to-clipboard pill buttons for sub-panels
• Hardened LAN transfer pipeline and HMAC peer discovery with fail-safe reconnect logic
• Notes journal view enhancements with top-of-list insertion and auto-save debouncing
• Living Shelf styling tokens, ambient shadows, and companion mascot animations
